name: Sun Cleric: Arbiter of Light boosts Gavel of Light's heal-from-damage passive by 100% (#1834)
contract: 302914 is ADD_FLAT_MODIFIER (aura 107), MiscValue 3 = SPELLMOD_EFFECT1, EffectSpellClassMask word 0 = 0x200000, matching the Gavel of Light passive's (707521) own SpellFamilyFlags word 0 (0x200000) exactly and no other family-33 spell -- SpellInfo::IsAffectedBySpellMod's generic flag96 AND admits it with no extra routing. But 302914's own EffectBasePoints_1 was -1, which SpellEffectInfo::CalcBaseValue resolves to 0 (DieSides 1 only ever subtracts one from the stored value; every correctly authored sibling in this class stores value-1, e.g. Blazing Chariot's 124 for '+125%'), so the SPELLMOD_EFFECT1 flat modifier this aura built always added zero regardless of routing -- a real bug, not a missing mechanism. The fix (AscensionSunClericValkyrie.cpp, the same GlobalScript::OnLoadSpellCustomAttr load-time patch) corrects BasePoints to 99, so the modifier now adds +100, matching 'your Gavel of Light now restores an additional 100% health equal to the damage dealt'. The already-existing AscensionSunClericAbilities.cpp OnSpellHitResult handler reads this exact value (Amount(707521)) and copies that percent of damage as a self-heal whenever Gavel of Light rank 1 (800611) lands with damage -- unmodified by this fix. This scenario fails on unpatched code (spell_effect_value would show a 0 delta) and passes once the BasePoints correction ships.

steps.label: While Vow of Light is active, Gavel of Light restores an additional 100% health
707521's own effect value rises by 100, not 0
